## B5. Configure Isaac Read Simulation Time

```
Isaac Read Simulation Time

```

Use simulation time.

If the node contains a property named:

```
resetOnStop

```

set it to:

```
False

```

![Screenshot from 2026-09-16 01-42-41](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1854ebc1-f635-4710-ac22-73aad3ac8827)

Leave reference time numerator and denominator at their default values.

The output should be:

```
simulationTime

```
## Objective

ROS2 nodes must use Isaac Sim simulation time. You will create a graph that publishes simulation time on:

```
/clock

```

Do not continue until `/clock` is working.
## Laboratory Roadmap

| Stage | Main task | Required result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A | Validate the starter USD | Robot simulates without ROS 2 |
| B | Publish `/clock` | ROS 2 receives simulation time |
| C | Control the robot | `/cmd_vel` moves the robot |
| D | Add lidar | `/scan` publishes LaserScan data |
| E | Add camera | Camera image topics publish |
| F | Publish odometry and TF | `odom → base_footprint` exists |
| G | Inspect QoS (optional) | QoS compatibility is understood |
| H | Run localization (optional) | AMCL publishes `map → odom` |
| I | Run Nav2 (optional) | Robot reaches a goal |
| J | Complete diagnostics (optional) | All required outputs are verified |
## B6. Configure the ROS2 Publish Clock node

```
ROS2 Publish Clock

```

```
Topic Name = /clock
Queue Size = 10

```

![Screenshot from 2026-09-16 01-44-49](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/57fe4ca8-f4ca-46b2-b01a-52c2849bff88)

If `qosProfile` is available, leave it at its default value.

```
On Playback Tick.outputs:tick
    →
ROS2 Publish Clock.inputs:execIn

```

```
Isaac Read Simulation Time.outputs:simulationTime
    →
ROS2 Publish Clock.inputs:timeStamp

```

The final connections must include:

```
On Playback Tick.tick
    → ROS2 Publish Clock.execIn

ROS2 Context.context
    → ROS2 Publish Clock.context

Isaac Read Simulation Time.simulationTime
    → ROS2 Publish Clock.timeStamp

```
